page.content:
French appellation d'origine contrôlée — legal name tied to place and practice.

How AOC connects

  • Topic: Old World wine — AOC is the French legal form of Old World place-naming.
  • Faction: INAO — The INAO defines and polices French appellations.
  • Topic: Terroir — AOC writes terroir into maps and permitted grapes.

What is AOC?

AOC (now part of AOP) is the French system that says Champagne, Médoc, or Gevrey must come from mapped land and follow rules. It is terroir written into statute.

Key threads lead to Old World wine, INAO and Terroir.
